note: Six songs come from the tape. Road Trips 4:2 carries this night's second set and encore whole but only "two songs from the first set" — When I Paint My Masterpiece and Let It Grow — because its three discs are mostly given to the complete April 1 show. The rest of set one takes its timings from gd1988-03-31.140328.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644, whose 23 tracks are these 20 songs plus two Tuning segments and an Encore Break, all three already excluded by data/songs.json. Against the release the tape runs within about twenty seconds on every shared track except Space, 6:22 on the release against 8:20 on the tape, which is where the segue into Goin' Down the Road is drawn rather than a cut; the release keeps those.
